fusions.name: Double Tap
fusions.desc: Fires 2 rounds in quick succession, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Overcharged Chamber
fusions.desc: Fires a double-loaded round that deals 34 damage and always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Running Hot
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rapid Cadence
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
